column8: Watch YouTube on Switch 2 with a TV-style interface. Requires VacooTube on a Linux PC and an active IZ2S connection.
Stream PC video and audio to Switch 2. Requires BlitBun on a Linux PC and an active IZ2S connection.
Browse and install Switch 2 homebrew.
Browse and install Switch 2 homebrew.
Listen to music stored on your SD card with a native audio player made for Switch 2.
Play your local NES and Famicom games on Switch 2. Includes save states and on-screen playback settings.
Back up and restore game saves from a console interface.
Manage compatible Pokemon game saves and organize local collections.
View console captures and transfer them to a browser over your local network.
Stream from your own PlayStation over Remote Play.
A small animated ASCII donut demo for Switch 2.
Experimental native YouTube client for Switch 2.
Route sound to the built-in speakers while the console is docked.
Cloud gaming client for Switch 2. Requires a compatible account and internet connection.
Early test port of Dolphin for Switch 2: GameCube and Wii emulation with Vulkan and JIT. Supply your own games. USB drives are not supported; performance and graphics vary by game.
Native mGBA port for Switch 2 homebrew. Play your own GBA games with sound, save states and screen modes. GB/GBC support is present but was not tested by the port author.

Unofficial Azahar 3DS emulator for Switch 2 with Vulkan, JIT and several screen layouts. Put your own decrypted games in /switch/Kaizhar/roms. First launches compile shaders; encrypted CIA files are refused.

Switch 2 port of OpenRCT2 with mouse and gamepad controls. Requires your own RollerCoaster Tycoon data in /switch/openrct2/rct2/ (or rct1/ for RCT1). The download contains the engine, not the original game.
Run DNS checks on Switch 2 to inspect Nintendo domain blocking. Displays test results; it does not change your console network settings.
Switch 2 port of Nic Cage Eats Stuff. A small arcade homebrew game published as a standalone NRO.
Bad Apple audiovisual demo, using the dedicated Ounce build for Switch 2. This is the Switch 2 release, not the separate Switch 1 binary.
Play your PlayStation games on Switch 2. Requires IZ2S and your own BIOS and game files.
Wii U emulator for Switch 2 under kaiHEN. Requires your own games and about 5.5 GiB of homebrew heap. USB drives and SaltyNX are not supported.
Nintendo 3DS emulator, using the Switch 2 port by Olmectron. Supply your own games. Shader caches rebuild after updating; asynchronous shader compilation is experimental.
Multi-connection file transfer and file management server for Switch 2. Use the upstream sw2xfer.py client on your PC; see the repository for setup.

Mod manager with console and browser interfaces. Requires a compatible Moader resident backend and matched patched HEN, installed separately. This download installs the console app only; follow the repository installation guide.
Homebrew catalog and downloader for Switch 2. Requires the upstream hbmenu/brewloader setup. This download installs brewstore.nro only; follow the repository instructions for the remaining setup.

System utility to inspect or modify the Switch 2 FunctionBlackList. Write operations persist across reboots and may affect Nintendo service access. Follow the upstream instructions. This is the latest release with a published Switch 2 NRO.
Native Jellyfin client using the Switch 2 port by Lucaspec72. Requires access to your Jellyfin server. This is the dedicated Switch 2 build.
Native media player for Switch 2 with Stremio-style streaming features. This entry uses the dedicated NX2 binary; an internet connection and upstream setup may be required.
Native GeForce NOW client for Switch 2. Requires a GeForce NOW account, a supported region and an internet connection. Uses the dedicated Switch 2 build.

SNES emulator for Switch 2 using Snes9x, with save states, rewind and shaders. Supply your own games in /roms/snes or select another folder in Settings. Version 1.0.1 is the current published release.
Unofficial Stremio client using the dedicated Switch 2 build. Requires your own configured add-ons and network access. Launch with full application memory; see the repository for setup.

Animal Crossing: New Horizons save editor for Switch 2. Close the game before editing; saves are backed up when opened and written when you confirm Save. Includes console and SD save editing; some desktop features are unavailable.
Internet radio player for Switch 2 under kaiHEN. Browse stations and save favourites. Requires a network connection; configuration is stored next to the application.

Native Android compatibility wrapper for Angry Birds Reloaded 2.2.16218. Requires your own APK libraries, assets and cursor images in /switch/abreloaded, plus kaiHEN ldr:ro support. This download installs only the wrapper; follow the repository setup guide.

Switch 2 port of the open-source NXEngine-evo engine for Cave Story. This entry uses the Ounce build. Follow the repository for game resources and controls; user data is stored relative to the NRO location.

Stream PC games from Sunshine over LAN or the built-in Tailscale tunnel. Requires a Sunshine host and kaiHEN 20261114c or newer. Select H.264 in Settings before streaming; the release notes report an AV1 startup issue.

Game and save backup, restore and file transfer utility for Switch 2. Requires the separately installed compatible kaiHEN fsipc-v1 runtime and SD helpers. This download updates only the app; follow the upstream runtime guide. Full backup/restore verification is still pending upstream.

Stream PC games to Switch 2 over your home network. Requires the punktfunk host on your PC, kaiHEN and full application memory. Handheld mode is recommended by the port author; pair with the PIN shown by your host.
Export your installed games, updates, DLC, ExeFS and RomFS to SD, FTP or USB. Requires kaiHEN 20261117b or newer and sufficient storage. Experimental; read the repository requirements before use.

PSP emulator port for Switch 2 with Vulkan and kaiHEN JIT. Supply your own games and launch with full application memory. This is davidkalil10's fork; the separate XITRIX fork adds experimental GameShare. Optional frame generation needs your own Lossless.dll.

Separate PPSSPP port for Switch 2 under kaiHEN. Includes experimental GameShare for local multiplayer with a second, unmodified Switch. Supply your own PSP games; see upstream for supported GameShare setup. This is distinct from davidkalil10's fork.

Early PlayStation 2 emulator for Switch 2 under kaiHEN, based on OunceSX2. Supply your own BIOS in /bios/ps2 and game dumps in /roms/ps2, or configure other folders. Includes per-game settings, save states and experimental Multitap support.

Experimental PS Vita emulator for Switch 2 using Vulkan and kaiHEN JIT. Launch with full application memory. Install firmware and fonts using the launcher or the upstream manual procedure; supply your own games and required licenses. Firmware and game data are not included.

Nintendo 3DS emulator fork with Switch 2 rendering improvements and experimental GameShare. Uses the dedicated Switch 2 build; provide your own game dumps. On first launch it can rename /switch/dekopon to /switch/toronja and move existing data; back up that folder if keeping both apps.

Experimental Switch 1 emulator running on Switch 2 under kaiHEN. Supply your own games and keys in /switch/eden/.local/share/eden/keys/. Expect crashes, stutter and missing graphics; one player, no touch or guest networking. No games, keys or firmware are included.

Save manager port for Switch 2 under kaiHEN. Back up and restore saves; backups are stored in /JKSV/. Close games before restoring. The interface defaults to Simplified Chinese; English and Japanese are available in Settings after restarting.
USB MTP file transfer between a PC and the Switch 2 SD card. Connect a USB data cable and use an MTP-capable file manager on the PC. No network connection is required.

Offline Pokemon save editor for Switch 2. Place exported save copies in /switch/PKForge/saves/ and export edits to /switch/PKForge/exports/. Optional portraits and local Mystery Gift catalogs are configured separately; editing works without them. Keep backups of your original saves.

Experimental Chromium browser using the dedicated Switch 2 launcher under kaiHEN. On first start it downloads the separate chromium-full.ext4 image (about 411 MiB), or place that image in /switch/chromium-nx/ manually. Requires enough free SD space and network access for online browsing.

Experimental third-party Discord client for Switch 2 under kaiHEN. Supports sign-in with 2FA, messages, reactions and console capture sharing. Requires a Discord account and network access. Upstream warns that third-party clients conflict with Discord's terms and may put accounts at risk.
